title: Reading Practice Test 08 – Logistics & Shipping
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông tin theo dõi đơn, e-mail, bài báo có chèn câu, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: vận chuyển, hải quan, kho bãi, bảo hiểm hàng hoá.

questions.content: The shipment was delayed ------- a mechanical problem with the delivery truck.
questions.explanation: 'owing to' = do, bởi (+ cụm danh từ). Các lựa chọn còn lại là liên từ, cần mệnh đề.

questions.content: Customers can track ------- packages online using the tracking number provided.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ 'packages' → 'their'.

questions.content: The new warehouse is ------- larger than the old one, with space for 10,000 pallets.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ nhấn mạnh cho so sánh hơn 'larger' → 'considerably' (đáng kể).

questions.content: All packages ------- more than 30 kilograms require special handling.
questions.explanation: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: packages (that weigh) → 'weighing'. Động từ chính của câu là 'require'.

questions.content: The logistics company ------- its delivery fleet with electric vans over the past two years.
questions.explanation: 'over the past two years' → hiện tại hoàn thành 'has replaced'.

questions.content: Please contact our customer service team ------- your package does not arrive within five business days.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện 'nếu kiện hàng không đến' → 'if'. 'unless' (trừ khi) sẽ tạo phủ định kép, sai nghĩa.

questions.content: Fragile items should be packed ------- to prevent damage during transport.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ bị động 'be packed' → trạng từ 'securely' (chắc chắn).

questions.content: The driver was asked to obtain a ------- from the customer upon delivery.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ 'a' cần danh từ; lấy 'chữ ký' của khách → 'signature'. 'sign' (danh từ) = biển báo.

questions.content: Orders placed on Saturday or Sunday will be processed on the ------- business day.
questions.explanation: 'the next business day' = ngày làm việc kế tiếp – cụm cố định.

questions.content: The company's shipping costs have risen ------- because of higher fuel prices.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'have risen' → trạng từ 'sharply' (tăng mạnh).

groups.passage:
To: All Customers
From: Speedline Freight
Subject: Holiday Shipping Schedule

As the holiday season approaches, we want to help you plan your shipments. To ensure delivery before December 25, domestic packages must be dropped off ---131--- December 18. International shipments require additional time and should be sent no later than December 10.

---132---. Our offices will be closed on December 25 and January 1, and no pickups or deliveries will take place on those days.

We also ---133--- customers to use our online booking system, which is available 24 hours a day. Booking online saves time and gives you access to exclusive ---134---.

Thank you for choosing Speedline Freight.

questions.explanation: Hạn chót gửi hàng → 'by December 18' (chậm nhất ngày 18/12).

options.B: Please note that our hours will be different during the holidays.
options.C: We opened our first office in 1990.
options.D: Winter has been unusually cold this year.

questions.explanation: Câu sau nêu các ngày văn phòng đóng cửa → câu chèn giới thiệu việc thay đổi giờ làm dịp lễ.
Chủ ngữ 'We' + hiện tại đơn; cấu trúc encourage + O + to V → 'encourage'.
Sau tính từ 'exclusive' cần danh từ; không có mạo từ nên dùng số nhiều 'discounts' (ưu đãi riêng).

groups.passage:
TRACKING DETAILS – Package TX44820193
Shipped from: Globetech Supplies, Dallas, TX
Ship to: R. Kaminski, 45 Lake Road, Madison, WI
Service: Standard Ground, 3–5 business days

Status history
Oct. 2, 4:15 P.M. – Picked up, Dallas, TX
Oct. 3, 11:40 P.M. – Arrived at sorting center, Kansas City, MO
Oct. 5, 6:20 A.M. – Delayed: severe weather in the region

questions.content: What is indicated about the package?

options.B: It was sent by express service.
options.C: Its delivery was held up by bad weather.
options.D: It must be picked up at a sorting center.

questions.explanation: 'Delayed: severe weather in the region' → bị chậm do thời tiết xấu. (B) sai – dịch vụ Standard Ground.

questions.content: When is the package expected to arrive?
questions.explanation: 'Estimated delivery: Oct. 6, by end of day.'

groups.passage:
From: Hana Sato, Blue Ocean Logistics
To: Richard Moyo, Moyo Imports
Date: July 8
Subject: Container arrival

Dear Mr. Moyo,

I am writing to update you on your shipment of kitchen appliances from Shanghai. The container arrived at the Port of Long Beach yesterday, two days later than scheduled because of congestion at the port.

The container is currently going through customs inspection, which usually takes two to three days. Once it has been cleared, our trucks will deliver it to your warehouse in Riverside. We expect delivery on July 12.

Please note that storage fees will apply if the container remains at the port for more than five days. To avoid additional charges, please make sure the import documents we requested last week are sent to us as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Hana Sato

questions.content: Why was the container late?

options.A: There was bad weather at sea.

questions.explanation: '…because of congestion at the port' – congestion = ùn tắc → cảng quá đông.

questions.content: What will happen after the customs inspection?

options.A: The container will be delivered by truck.
options.B: The container will be shipped back to Shanghai.
options.C: Mr. Moyo will inspect the appliances at the port.
options.D: The storage fees will be refunded.

questions.explanation: 'Once it has been cleared, our trucks will deliver it to your warehouse in Riverside.'

questions.content: What does Ms. Sato ask Mr. Moyo to do?
questions.explanation: 'Please make sure the import documents… are sent to us as soon as possible.'

groups.passage:
Drones Take Off for Rural Deliveries

FARMINGTON – Residents of rural Harlan County can now receive medical supplies by drone, thanks to a pilot program launched by SkyDrop Logistics last month. The small aircraft can carry packages weighing up to 2.5 kilograms and travel as far as 30 kilometers. [1]

Before the program started, some residents had to drive more than an hour to reach the nearest pharmacy. [2] Now, prescriptions can arrive within 40 minutes of being ordered.

SkyDrop plans to expand the service to three more counties next year if the pilot is successful. [3] However, the company must first obtain approval from national aviation authorities, a process that can take several months. [4]

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.D: A new delivery method in a rural area

questions.explanation: Bài báo về việc giao thuốc bằng drone cho cư dân vùng nông thôn.

questions.content: What is stated about the drones?

options.C: They can carry a limited weight.
options.D: They are operated by a pharmacy.

questions.explanation: '…can carry packages weighing up to 2.5 kilograms' → giới hạn trọng lượng.

questions.content: The word "pilot" in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'a pilot program' = chương trình thí điểm → trial. Không phải nghĩa 'phi công' (captain).

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Deliveries are currently limited to daylight hours and good weather conditions."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn nêu thêm giới hạn hoạt động của drone, nối tiếp câu mô tả tải trọng và tầm bay → vị trí [1].

Order Confirmation – Parcel Express
Sender: Lina Park, Park Ceramics (business account)
Recipient: Harbor Gift Shop, Portland
Package weight: 4 kg
Service selected: Priority
Declared value of contents: $450
Charge: $16.20

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: support@parcelexpress.com
From: Lina Park
Date: March 14
Subject: Damaged shipment

Hello,

On March 9, I sent a package of handmade vases to Harbor Gift Shop in Portland. The shop's owner informed me yesterday that two of the six vases arrived broken, even though the package was clearly marked "Fragile."

I understand that my shipment was insured, but only for part of its value. Could you tell me how to file a claim? In the future, I would like to purchase additional insurance for shipments like this one. Please let me know whether this is possible.

Thank you,
Lina Park

questions.content: According to the Web page, what is included with Priority service?
questions.explanation: 'Priority and Overnight include tracking and insurance up to $100.'

questions.content: What is suggested about Park Ceramics?

options.A: It received a discount on shipping.
options.D: It sent a package weighing over 5 kg.

questions.explanation: Là tài khoản doanh nghiệp nên được giảm 10%: Priority 1–5 kg giá $18 → trả $16.20.

questions.content: Up to what amount was Ms. Park's package insured?
questions.explanation: Dịch vụ Priority bảo hiểm tối đa $100, dù hàng trị giá $450 → cô nói 'insured, but only for part of its value'.

questions.content: What problem does Ms. Park report?

options.A: A package was delivered to the wrong address.
options.D: Some of the contents were broken.

questions.explanation: 'Two of the six vases arrived broken.'

questions.content: What does Ms. Park want to know?

options.A: Whether she can buy more coverage in the future
options.B: How to open a business account

questions.explanation: 'I would like to purchase additional insurance for shipments like this one. Please let me know whether this is possible.'
